import json
p='4efe2031-a4cb-448a-a97d-ace00b4700bd.jsonl'

first_ts=last_ts=None
bad=0
for i,line in enumerate(open(p),1):

    try: o=json.loads(line)

    k=(o.get('type'),o.get('subtype'))

        if not first_ts: first_ts=ts
        last_ts=ts
print('types:',types)
print('first_ts:',first_ts,'last_ts:',last_ts)
print('bad lines:',bad)
"
